scope.model: tiny synthetic Qwen3.5 hybrid text model

api.selection: exactly one explicitly selected linear-attention layer

state_contract.prefill: CPU executes the selected GDN layer, then the exact F32 query/key/value K-sample convolution suffixes and F32 recurrent matrix seed both Metal state buffers
state_contract.decode_submission: one Metal command buffer, one commit, one wait, six dispatches
state_contract.output_handoff: the Metal attention output is copied to an F32 CPU Tensor; CPU executes residual, post-attention norm, MLP, and all unselected layers
state_contract.ownership: after the first committed Metal decode, an unsupported multi-token continuation fails closed until reset instead of using stale CPU GDN state
state_contract.metal_error: terminal; no CPU attention fallback, no global position advance, no active/scratch state swap, no receipt increment
state_contract.reset: clears both Metal state buffers, marks the block unseeded, clears GDN receipts, and requires a new CPU prefill seed
